penz_home2_fisher.text: Newlyn harbour is my patch. It is one of the busiest fishing ports in England.
Baskling come into the bay in summer with their mouths open. They only eat plankton, so say hello.
On 23 December in Mousehole, folk eat Stargazy pie, with fish heads poking out the crust. It remembers Tom Bawcock, who caught fish in a storm.
